facts.statement: Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings 2027 ranks SR University #6 in India in Research Quality and #7 among private universities nationwide.
facts.source: Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings 2027

facts.statement: SR University is the 1st private university across the Telugu States (Telangana and Andhra Pradesh) to earn coveted ICAR accreditation for its School of Agricultural Sciences.
facts.source: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) Accreditation Order

facts.statement: NIRF 2025 ranked SR University 91st in India in the Engineering category, marking 4 consecutive years in India's Top 100 engineering institutions.
facts.source: National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) 2025, Ministry of Education, Govt of India

facts.statement: QS Asia University Rankings 2027 ranks SR University 19th among private universities in India (band 701-710 in Asia).
SR University is established under Telangana State Private Universities Act 2018, recognized under UGC Section 2(f), and holds Tier-1 NBA accreditation across eligible B.Tech programs.
facts.source: Telangana State Gazette Act No. 13 of 2018 & UGC 2(f) Notification

facts.statement: SR University maintains a 6 to 6.5 LPA average package across engineering disciplines, with top offers reaching ₹51 LPA (Microsoft, Batch 2025), ₹49.30 LPA (ServiceNow, Batch 2027), and ₹46.38 LPA (Amazon, Batch 2026).
facts.source: Center for Student Services and Placements (CSSP) Official Placement Audit 2025-2027

facts.statement: SR University provides 100% placement assistance and rigorous interview/coding preparation through the Center for Student Services and Placements (CSSP) and Career Guidance Cell (CGC). Individual job offers depend on student interview performance and skill clearance; offers are never blindly guaranteed.
SR Innovation Exchange (SRiX) is a DST-supported Technology Business Incubator hosting 171+ startups, ₹76+ Cr in funding, 14+ maker spaces, an IoT & ESDM lab, and a 3D rapid prototyping facility.
facts.source: Department of Science and Technology (DST) & SRiX Annual Report

facts.statement: SR University hosts 11 interdisciplinary research centers, 14+ maker spaces at SRiX, and dedicated departmental teaching laboratories across all 6 specialized schools on its 170-acre campus.
facts.source: Academic Affairs & Dean of Engineering Infrastructure Directory 2027-28

facts.statement: Hostel in-time is strictly 8:30 PM for first-year residential students (with biometric roll call). For senior students, in-time is 9:00 PM on weekdays and 9:30 PM on weekends. Campus operates 24/7 security, wardens, CCTV, and an on-campus health dispensary.
facts.source: Office of Chief Warden, Student Residential Handbook 2027-28

facts.statement: Hostels offer 3-sharing and 4-sharing AC and Non-AC rooms (ranging from ₹1,15,000 to ₹1,35,000/year). All hostel packages include 4 nutritious daily meals in the 4,000-seat Mega Dining Hall, Wi-Fi, laundry, and round-the-clock maintenance.

For academic session 2027-28, B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) tuition is ₹3,40,000 per year (₹1,70,000 per semester), plus ₹5,000 one-time enrollment, ₹15,000/yr other academic charges, and ₹5,000/yr examination fee. An annual ₹9,000 escalation applies to tuition in future academic years.
For academic session 2027-28, B.Tech Artificial Intelligence & Robotics tuition is ₹4,00,000 per year (₹2,00,000 per semester). Merit scholarships up to 40% apply.

SR University awards merit scholarships of 10% to 40% tuition fee waiver based on 10+2 Intermediate board percentage (95%+ / 985+ marks: 40%; 80%+: 25%; 70%+: 20%; 60%+: 10%), JEE Main percentile, or TG/AP EAPCET rank.

SR University provides 19 special-category fee concessions ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹50,000 per year (for orphans, sports champions, staff children, single parent, defence ward, sibling at SRU, AP residents, girl child non-TS).

Minimum eligibility for B.Tech programs is 50% aggregate marks in 10+2 / Intermediate PCM/B. Admission is strictly merit-based, subject to seat availability and certificate verification. SR University never guarantees or reserves seats unconditionally for any score.
